Module com.example.projectpoker
Package com.example.projectpoker.model.game

Class PotUtil

java.lang.Object
com.example.projectpoker.model.game.PotUtil
public final class PotUtil extends Object
Utility class for pot management during a poker round. Handles side-pot creation, bet routing, and pot selection logic.

  • Method Details

    • addNewSidePot

      public static ArrayList<Pot> addNewSidePot(ArrayList<Pot> pots, Player p, int newPotSize)
      Creates a new side pot for the given player at the appropriate priority level, redistributes existing pot chips, and adds the side pot to the list.
      Parameters:
      pots - the current list of all Pot objects in play
      p - the Player who triggered the side-pot creation (typically by going all-in)
      newPotSize - the chip amount that seeds the new side pot
      Returns:
      the updated list of pots including the newly created side pot

    • setPotsToPlay

      public static void setPotsToPlay(ArrayList<Pot> pots, int toPlay)
      Sets the amount-to-play on the correct open pot(s) so every player knows how much they must contribute in the current betting round.
      Parameters:
      pots - the current list of Pot objects
      toPlay - the total amount a player with no prior investment must pay

    • getToCall

      public static int getToCall(ArrayList<Pot> pots, Player p)
      Computes the exact chip amount a player must put in to remain in the hand. Accounts for multiple open pots and the player's existing contributions.
      Parameters:
      pots - the current list of Pot objects
      p - the Player whose call amount is calculated
      Returns:
      the positive integer number of chips the player still needs to contribute, or 0 if they are already matched or all amounts are settled

    • handlePlayerBet

      public static ArrayList<Pot> handlePlayerBet(ArrayList<Pot> pots, Player p)
      Routes a player's active bet into the appropriate pot(s). Tries to distribute across multiple open pots first; falls back to the single open pot.
      Parameters:
      pots - the current list of Pot objects
      p - the Player whose activeBet amount should be placed
      Returns:
      the updated list of pots after the bet has been recorded

    • findHighestPriorityPot

      public static Pot findHighestPriorityPot(ArrayList<Pot> pots)
      Returns the pot with the lowest (highest-priority) potPriority value that is still open. This is usually the main pot or the most recently created side pot that controls betting.
      Parameters:
      pots - the current list of Pot objects; must not be empty
      Returns:
      the highest-priority open Pot
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if pots is empty

    • findBestAvailablePot

      public static Pot findBestAvailablePot(ArrayList<Pot> pots, Player player)
      Returns the most suitable open pot for a specific player to bet into, preferring pots the player is already registered in.
      Parameters:
      pots - the current list of Pot objects; must not be empty
      player - the Player looking for a pot to bet into
      Returns:
      the best available Pot for this player
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if pots is empty

    • getOpenPotIndex

      public static Integer getOpenPotIndex(ArrayList<Pot> pots)
      Returns the index of the single open pot in the list, or null if there are multiple open pots.
      Parameters:
      pots - the current list of Pot objects
      Returns:
      the zero-based index of the sole open pot, or null if more than one pot is open
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if all pots are closed or if there is only one pot and it is closed
